# Specialized Maintenance Agent

A custom agent for deep maintenance tasks: file cleanup, dependency updates, error checks, and integration with hooks. Runs maintenance workflows and logs results.

## Example Prompts
- "Run specialized maintenance agent for scripts."
- "Clean up unused files and dependencies."
- "Integrate hooks for automated maintenance."
